mapper.select: select distinct zz.portfolioId, zz.portfolioName, zz.acctNo, zz.acctName, zz.ccy, zz.acctType, sd.institution_code instCode from( select portfolioId, portfolioName, acctNo, acctName, ccy, acctType, (case when CASH_FLOW_AMOUNT99 is not null then CASH_AMOUNT03 + CASH_FLOW_AMOUNT99 else CASH_AMOUNT03 end) as cashBalance from ( select portfolioId, portfolioName, acctNo, acctName, t.ccy as ccy, acctType, nvl(CASH_AMOUNT03,0) as CASH_AMOUNT03, nvl(CASH_FLOW_AMOUNT99,0) as CASH_FLOW_AMOUNT99 from( select t.portfolio_id as portfolioId, t.portfolio_name as portfolioName, t2.acct_no as acctNo, t2.acct_name as acctName, t2.ccy as ccy, t1.acct_type as acctType from PTL_PORTFOLIO t INNER JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO t1 on t1.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id INNER JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO t2 on t2.acct_no = t1.acct_no group by t.portfolio_id, t.portfolio_name, t2.acct_no, t2.acct_name, t2.ccy, t1.acct_type )t left join ( select portfolio_id, acct_id, ccy, sum(nvl(AMOUNT,0)) CASH_AMOUNT03 from PTL_CASH_POSITION where cdate = to_date(#{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and hoding_type = '03' group by portfolio_id, acct_id, ccy )t3 on t3.portfolio_id = t.portfolioId and t3.acct_id = t.acctNo and t3.ccy = t.ccy left join ( select portfolio_id, acct_id, ccy, sum(nvl(AMOUNT,0)) CASH_FLOW_AMOUNT99 /**手工调整**/ from PTL_CASH_POSITION_FLOW where cdate = to_date(#{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd') and hoding_type = '99' group by portfolio_id, acct_id, ccy )t4 on t4.portfolio_id = t.portfolioId and t4.acct_id = t.acctNo and t4.ccy = t.ccy )z )zz inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.portfolio_id = zz.portfolioId inner join sys_department sd on sd.dept_code = pp.create_dept where cashBalance < 0 order by portfolioId desc,acctNo desc
